3:9.text: Give thy servant therefore an understanding mind to govern thy people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to govern this thy great people?
3:9.notes: Agrees word for word with the RSVCE entry (bible-history.com). Ch. 11, 2026-10-06.

3:10.text: It pleased the Lord that Solomon had asked this.
